descriptor.scene: A ROOMFUL OF PEOPLE is the subject. In a good ordinary working room, six young founders stand and sit in loose knots, mid-conversation, laptops and mugs among them. GARY stands at frame LEFT in his light-wash denim jacket with the yellow smiley patch on the left chest and the orange pixel-mascot patch on the right chest, listening to a founder, head tilted. DAVID KOBROSKY stands at frame RIGHT near the plain door, greeting an arriving founder. Warm evening lamp light, big plain windows showing dusk. The room stays ordinary: mismatched chairs, a whiteboard with half-erased diagrams, printouts taped to the wall. Keep the bottom-right quarter calm, plain floor and soft light. If the room is empty of people the image is wrong.
descriptor._caption: There is a room in San Francisco where agentic startups learn to fly. It is not a stage and it is not a showroom. It is a good ordinary room with a plain door, and on Thursdays the door is open. Come on Thursday. Leave flying.
descriptor.anonymous: six founders in their twenties and thirties, varied builds and skin tones, casual clothes, mid-conversation in loose knots
